steps.instruction: Read the request and declared current inventory. Bind one route key, one ladder rung, fixed port claims, desired-state digest, allowed effects, mutable ceiling, capability custody, environment authority, and session commit plus owned paths for serve. No declaration grants itself authority.

calls.purpose: Read desired state, authority and inventory evidence.
Read routed checkout and commit provenance.

steps.instruction: Re-observe the route entry, process, generation, served head, configuration, health and every fixed-port holder before effects. Classify reusable, missing, invalid, foreign or uncertain state and acquire the declared lease order.

Perform only the selected rung's allowed delta under the lease. Reuse already-converged state. For serve, merge the session commit into the fixed integration branch without rebase or force, resolve only owned rule-covered hunks, gate the merged head, then operate the one detached server. Never reclaim a foreign port.

reads.when: when the rung needs a checkout

writes.when: only for the serve rung's integration merge

calls.purpose: Merge and verify the integration head without rebase or force.

calls.when: for stack-up, start-role, restart, reset or stop when container-backed

calls.purpose: Run declared role, gate and process commands.
calls.when: when required by the selected rung

calls.purpose: Persist the exact allowed and applied delta.

steps.instruction: After any mutation or uncertain result, re-inventory the entry, process, port and served head before further commands. Probe every declared endpoint and collect the rung's complete check set. A converged no-op uses paired read-only observations and records zero mutations.

calls.when: unless the selected rung is stop

steps.instruction: Compare authority, inventory, fixed ports, integration provenance, delta and attestation. Produce exact defects and a receipt only when every required rung check passes; uncertain effects remain observed and never blindly repeated.
produces: Concrete failed-criterion feedback or passing review results.

steps.instruction: Write and validate the response with exact hashes, observations and review results. Present the route as serving only from passed endpoint and rung evidence; stop results show the released holder instead.

calls.purpose: Present the attested route, generation and served head.
